item.tib: tshogs kyi rgyud skong rin chen phra rgyan
item.coloph: de ltar rgyud skong rin chen phra rgyan 'di/ dpal ldan bla ma'i bka'i rtsol bzhin du/ bon nag slob ming drung mu nyi wer gyis/'du gnas bkra shis sman ri'i dgon gnas su/ shing rta zla ba dang po'i yar tshes kyi/ rje cig mnyam med chen po'i dus chen skabs/ thos shar bgyis pas bstan pa'i rgyan gyur cig rjes 'jug thugs kyis bzhed don 'grub par smon//
